title: OwnersRegistry
description: The people who own flags, dashboards, alerts and runbooks, and the roles that group them (planning/14 §7, §11; ADR-0007). Everything else references a person or role by id, so adding or changing an owner is a data edit, never a code change. No contact details: emails and phone numbers never enter the repository (planning/11 §8); alert delivery membership lives in Grafana. Every role member must be a declared person id (checked by packages/shared-kernel/tests).

id.description: Stable kebab-case person id; referenced from other registries, never renamed

roles.description: Role name (kebab-case) to the person ids that hold it, so a dashboard, alert or flag can point at a role instead of a person
